These unmodified Apple gain-map JPEG fixtures come from [Google libultrahdr](https://github.com/google/libultrahdr/tree/66821e0a261aa3a06c0e7c889f52eced52850be1/tests/data), revision `66821e0a261aa3a06c0e7c889f52eced52850be1`. Attribution: Google libultrahdr contributors.

The upstream fixtures are licensed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The original license is retained in [LICENSE](LICENSE). Both files are copied unchanged. They exercise HDR JPEG admission through the production picture codec, where a conventional decoder sees only the SDR base.
